تقلعففن (form IVq)
# تَقْلَعْفِفْنَ (taqlaʕfifna) /taq.laʕ.fif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# تُقْلَعْفَفْنَ (tuqlaʕfafna) /tuq.laʕ.faf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
